$comment: Spanish typography as macOS es writes it: “…” primary (641 opening marks across the pile's Finder/AppKit/System Settings values, for example ¿Borrar “%@”?, and no «…» in any Spanish value), ‘…’ nested (RAE's order inside “…”). Spanish has no apostrophe. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: an opening ¿, ¡, or quote hugs the next word
a closing quote hugs the previous word
a multiplier spells out veces (4 veces), never 4x

hedges.why: a bracketed gender or plural ending (archivo(s), listo(a)); use ICU plural/select, or rephrase
a slashed gender or plural ending (listo/a, usuarios/as; /s is the per-second unit and stays out); rephrase with tú or a neutral noun
a slashed article or pronoun hedging an unknown gender; name the noun (la carpeta {name}) or rephrase
an inclusive @, x, or e ending (usuari@s, todxs, todes); restructure to tú or a neutral noun
